title: Patriots trade up to No. 28, take Caleb Lomu

sources.title: Patriots trade up to No. 28, take Caleb Lomu
sources.description: After the 28th overall pick in the 2026 NFL draft was traded twice, the Patriots ended up with it and selected Utah offensive tackle Caleb Lomu.
